Hunaiza, Ek Baat Dil Se... 💌

Agar meri kisi bhi baat se tumhe kabhi hurt hua ho, chahe woh baat mujhe us waqt chhoti lagi ho, phir bhi main dil se tumse maafi chahta hoon. ❤️

Mera intention kabhi tumhe hurt karna nahi tha. Agar meri kisi baat, meri kisi mistake ya mere kisi behaviour se tumhe bura laga ho, toh please mujhe maaf kar dena. 🫂

Main sirf “Sorry” nahi kehna chahta... main chahta hoon ke aage se sab kuch aur better ho.

Aur agar koi baat tumhe mujhse zyada badi lagi ho, toh uske liye bhi I’m genuinely sorry. ❤️

Tum mere liye important ho, aur main nahi chahta ke meri kisi galti ki wajah se humare beech phir se distance aaye. ❤️

Let’s Leave The Past Behind 🕊️

Hamari kuch fights past ki wajah se bhi hui hain... lekin ab main nahi chahta ke woh past dobara humare beech aaye.

Jo kuch ho gaya, woh ho gaya. Hum us cheez ko change nahi kar sakte, lekin hum apna present zaroor better bana sakte hain. ❤️

Hum old memories ya old matters ko dobara discuss nahi karenge.

Na main tumhare past ko tumhare against use karunga, na hi purani baaton ko baar baar lekar aaunga.

Agar kabhi koi baat mujhe badi lagi ho, ya meri kisi baat se tumhara dil dukha ho, toh uske liye bhi dil se sorry aur maafi. 🫂

Ab past ko wahi chhod dete hain jahan woh hai... aur apne present ko importance dete hain. ❤️

What Matters Now? ❤️

Past nahi... ab sirf Arslan & Hunaiza.

Mere liye ab sabse important hum hain, humara rishta hai aur humara present hai.

Main tumhare past ko kabhi tumhare khilaaf use nahi karna chahta.

Jo ho gaya, use wahi chhod dete hain.
